title: Transformer architecture published
before: Strong NLP models often relied on recurrent or convolutional sequence architectures that were harder to parallelize at extreme scale.
problem: Sequence modeling needed better parallel training and long-range dependency handling.
change: The paper 'Attention Is All You Need' introduced the transformer, centering multi-head self-attention and feed-forward blocks.
whyItMattered: It became the dominant backbone for modern large language and multimodal models.
enabled: Large-scale pretraining, generative assistants, and many production NLP systems.
concreteExample: Chat-style coding assistants are typically powered by transformer-based models.
caveat: Transformers did not invent AI; they improved a scalable architecture within a much longer AI history.
